checks.explanation: No overlapping CIDRs across AWS VPCs and GCP subnets
checks.evidence_path: aws vars.yaml + gcp vars.yaml (all vpc/subnet cidrs)

checks.explanation: All GKE envs declare adequately sized secondary ranges
No inspection VPC / firewall stacks exist for aws us-stg or eu-stg; spokes egress via local NAT/IGW (G3.A closes this)
Perimeter covers all 2 declared stg projects; restricted services derived from declared APIs in the stack hcl
No DataClassification / data-classification tag scheme declared in either vars.yaml common block, so regulated/non-regulated co-tenancy is unverifiable (G3-14 / G4-4 close this)
explicit-off: ['us-stg/aurora: storage_encrypted=false', 'eu-stg/aurora: storage_encrypted=false', 'us-dev/aurora: storage_encrypted=false']; default-key-only: 12 services
Missing CMEK wiring: ['stg/eu: svc-redis has no CMEK key reference', 'dev/eu: svc-sql has no CMEK key reference', 'dev/eu: svc-redis has no CMEK key reference']
Wired services resolve to declared KMS keys: ['stg/eu/svc-sql->sql']
checks.evidence_path: gcp vars.yaml envs.stg.*.resources.kms.inputs.keys vs stack hcl wiring

checks.explanation: Org policy stack exists (constraint list verified in G4)
No Allow-Effect policy document grants Action:*
All GKE stacks wire identity_namespace (Workload Identity)
CloudTrail stack exists but log-file validation / retention not declared in vars
Audit stack exists but no retention period declared in vars
No dr_region key anywhere in AWS vars.yaml; no cross-region copy targets declared
GCP stg regions ['eu'] != prod regions ['eu', 'us']; stg cannot rehearse prod's multi-region posture
Every env stack resolves to a vars.yaml key
budget keys present: aws=False, gcp=False; need per-env budgets with >= 2 thresholds (G3-11 / G4-13)
